meta_description:
2,792 likes, 19K comments - simrun.chopra on September 30, 2026: "Comment "breakfast" and ill send you recipes and 100 high protein breakfast ideas for vegetarian as well as egg based ideas
 
You do not need to feel like youre missing out
Here are some example 

If you eat the following these are just carbs 
Poha 
Upma 
Dosa chutney
Idli chutney 
Roti sabzi 

The way to balanf3 these would be 
Poha with lots of veggies + high protein curd 
Upma with lots of veggies + high protein curd 
Dosa chutney + tofu / paneer bhurjee or sambaar 
Idli chutney + sambaar 
Roti sabzi + paneer bhurjee / tofu / curd 

Its not hard to do... it just something that needs to be learnt. 

Hope this helps 
Love 
Sim".
